primary_source_finding: User 13 operating Phone 17 accounts for 622 of the 637 redundant duplicate records (97.6%). These duplicates are heavily concentrated on Floor 4 of Building 2 (375 records) and Floor 1 of Building 1 (218 records). Analysis of consecutive sample timestamps indicates rapid repeated fingerprinter logging at identical physical test locations.
preprocessing_recommendation: Duplicates should NOT be removed in Task 03 per prompt constraints. In Task 04, deduplication should be offered as a configurable preprocessing option to prevent synthetic data leakage into cross-validation folds.
